newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Tai Yung defaults on debts.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Tai Yung defaults on debts.

text.p: South Korea's Tai Yung Paper Board Manufacturing Co Ltd defaulted on 236 million won worth of promissory notes on Wednesday, a company statement said on Thursday.
The statement said the company had already missed payments on 1.55 billion won worth of notes on Tuesday, and was considering applying for court receivership.
Tai Yung shares have been suspended from trading since Wednesday.
The Korea Stock Exchange said on Thursday the company's shares would resume trading on Saturday.
